title: CaptureCloseRequest
description: Close capture. New chunks are rejected, identical stored retries remain available. True preserves queued research; false requests cooperative cancellation without removing published results. Identical close requests replay; a different effective duration or choice returns CAPTURE_CLOSE_CONFLICT. Close remains available after the upload window expires.

duration_ms.description: Final capture-relative duration, 0 through 180000. Omitted/null uses the highest received end (zero if empty). Supply it to expose trailing missing intervals. Cannot truncate received chunks or extend past a received short final chunk.
